designDecisionsTakenAfterSeeingTrainOutc: S1 -> S1b: universe restricted to quoted (unadjusted) price >= 5 USD after the S1 diagnostic showed that penny-stock survivors (min quoted price < 1 USD, e.g. MITK, IESC, LPTH) drive the extreme S1 results (MOM3-N20 50% CAGR, LOWBETA-N10 54%).
S2/S3 variants chosen around the better S1b/S2 signals (momentum 3/6 months, 12-1 momentum with 1-month reversal, trend stability, value+profitability+momentum, quality).
FUND universe fixed a priori at quoted price >= 5 USD and PIT market cap >= 300 Mio USD (one size variant each at 1 bn and without cap filter).
gardenOfForkingPaths.note: Every evaluated variant is listed; nothing was dropped. Walk-forward within TRAIN (wf-train) measures whether choosing the best explored variant has out-of-sample value.

investment: fully invested except market filter / exit rules (cash earns 0)
benchmarks: SPY price, EW own universe, EW frame population, PIT cap-weighted population (FUND 2011+)
survivorship: TRAIN populations contain no delisted firm (all frame series end 2023 or later). The EW universe beats SPY by ~9 pp/yr in price TRAIN mostly because of this conditioning; the own-universe EW is therefore the selection-skill benchmark.
columns: cagr/sharpe/maxDrawdown/turnoverPerYear of the strategy (base costs); ex* = annualised mean weekly excess and block-bootstrap p (26 w); halves = annualised excess in the two TRAIN halves
